title: Answer: intelligence is the capacity for sophisticated goal-directed behavior, distinct from consciousness

statements.text: Intelligence is roughly the capacity for sophisticated goal-directed behavior and is not the same as consciousness. Consciousness is in some respects a lower bar than human-level intelligence, since many animals are conscious, so AI could reach consciousness before human-level intelligence.

sources.quote: Consciousness also should not be identified with intelligence, which I understand as roughly the capacity for sophisticated goal-directed behavior.
It’s not out of the question that AI might as well.
